notes: Four loop tracks and a multitrack recorder - the mix, any part on its own, and the MIDI, to whichever drive you point it at. Eight more effects, with a filter and a wah the mod wheel opens rather than fades. The ping-pong delay works, and every delay now follows the tempo. In a DAW the rig follows the session's transport and bar lines. There is a click, a count-in, and a panel you can choose the colour of.
